components.name: Primary Raycast Button
components.description: High-impact CTA with top specular highlight, electric volt gradient, and neon bloom.
components.css: .ds-btn-raycast { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(198, 255, 52, 0.95) 0%, rgba(198, 255, 52, 0.75) 100%); color: #000000; padding: 14px 36px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 4px 16px rgba(198, 255, 52, 0.15); text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-raycast:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(212, 255, 102, 1) 0%, rgba(198, 255, 52, 0.9) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4), 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 8px 32px rgba(198, 255, 52, 0.35); } .ds-btn-raycast:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); } .ds-arrow { font-family: monospace; font-weight: bold; }

components.name: Secondary Outlined Button
components.description: Subtle outlined action button for secondary paths and documentation links.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #27272a; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #121212; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #a1a1aa; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input-dark { background: #121212; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input-dark::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input-dark:focus { border-color: #c6ff34; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(198, 255, 52, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: NeuralBI is an enterprise architecture platform engineered to communicate precision, velocity, and cognitive power. Rejecting the bland conventions of legacy corporate IT consulting and disposable SaaS templates, NeuralBI adopts an obsidian foundation with tactile glassmorphism, physical inset lighting, and high-voltage accents. The interface functions as a precision telemetry instrument, synthesizing schematics, 2D blueprint graphics, and live data telemetry into an environment that feels both industrial and extraordinarily refined.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian Foundation: Deep true-black backdrops (#000000) with high-contrast, pure-white typographic hierarchy.
Physical Inset Bevels: Multi-layered box shadows with top-edge specular highlights creating physical depth.
Electric Volt Accents: Strategic deployment of high-chroma volt lime (#c6ff34) reserved for primary actions and active telemetry states.
Cognitive Secondary Accents: Neural Indigo (#6366f1) for AI reasoning and Mesh Cyan (#38bdf8) for telemetry.
Tactile Bento Glassmorphism: Translucent dark container cards with 24px backdrop blur and delicate perimeter glow.

rules.name: The 10% Volt Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (#c6ff34) must never occupy more than 10% of any given viewport. Its power comes directly from its scarcity against the deep obsidian field.

rules.name: The True Black Foundation Rule
rules.body: Surfaces must never default to charcoal, slate blue, navy, or desaturated brown as background canvas. The ground is #000000.

rules.name: The Strict Font Stack Rule
rules.body: Only fonts defined in the official stack (Sora, Manrope, Schibsted Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, Absolut) may be rendered. System defaults or unapproved Google Fonts are forbidden.

rules.name: The Inset Edge Rule
rules.body: Every elevated or clickable surface must feature an internal 1px specular highlight along its top border (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1..0.8)).

rules.name: The State-Driven Glow Rule
rules.body: Ambient neon glow effects must never be statically pinned across every card simultaneously; they ignite in response to hover, cursor proximity, or live streaming.

dos: Do anchor all views in deep obsidian black (#000000) to preserve dramatic contrast.
Do strictly limit Volt Lime (#c6ff34) to key interactive conversion triggers, active states, and critical ROI metrics.
Do use multi-layered inset highlights on buttons and glass cards to maintain a tactile, physical quality.
Do preserve the exact typography stack: Sora for headings, Manrope for paragraphs, JetBrains Mono for telemetry tags.
Do write crisp, assertive engineering copy that speaks to enterprise directors and CTOs with concrete technical architectures.
donts: Don't use light, cream, beige, or sand background palettes under any circumstances.
Don't fall back to corporate IT consulting clichés (stock photos of handshakes, vague arrows, corporate blue swooshes).
Don't use standard Bootstrap or uncustomized Tailwind defaults.
Don't splash neon colors indiscriminately across borders, backgrounds, and paragraphs.
Don't introduce fonts outside the documented stack (no Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, or Comic Sans).
